integrity: Analytic proof of an infinite parameter family; finite numerical checks are supplemental and do not constitute an independent proof or audit. Literature comparisons made against cited results, not an exhaustive originality guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Unit-weight original star; only distinct leaf-to-leaf augmentations; 1 <= k <= floor(n/2); total added-conductance budget; not an optimization theorem for other bases or k beyond this domain. Quantitative coefficient is proven but not claimed sharp. Possible unindexed specialized antecedents remain a novelty risk.
title: Sharp matching design for budgeted augmentation of a star
